product_metadata.title: Bonnlo Vanity Table Set with Lighted Mirror Round Makeup Vanity Table with 8 Light Bulbs and Touch Switch,Bedroom Dressing Table with Cushioned Stool (Black)
features: 【Vanity Table with 8 Lighted Bulbs】Our new white dressing table features 8 light bulbs around the rim providing a natural daytime light that is perfect for makeup application, shaving, hair styling.It is especially helpful for nighttime makeup application when brightness is insufficient.

【Made to Last】Bonnlo black vanity table set is well made of superior MDF and solid wood legs which ensures its durability.The upper part with mirrors and drawers can be also removed to used as study, office or writing table.

【Lots of Storage Space】Not only it can add an element of glamour to a bedroom and ensure there is a comfortable, dedicated area for getting ready for the day ahead,but it also helps to keep free of clutter by providing ample space to store make-up, toiletries and other beauty essentials.2 tabletop drawers with a removable makeup organizer and 2 large sliding drawers keep everything neatly tucked away.

【Easy to Assemble】The table and sliding drawers will come intact, all you have to do is attaching legs and round mirror to the table and it's ready to use.It also comes with anti-toppling fittings for safe use.
【What You Will Get】Bonnlo provides excellent pre-sales and after-sales customer service,if for any reasons you're not satisfied with your purchase,just let us know,we're always happy to help!
